 Tigres 0 – 1 Live 36' Cruz Azul Live Updated 3 minutes ago Tigres vs Cruz Azul LIVE, Latest Score, Goals and Liga MX Updates (0-1)
 Follow Tigres vs Cruz Azul live score at Universitario Stadium, goals, team news, lineups, text commentary & Liga MX Apertura 2026 stats on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Juan Carlos Vera López Updated November 7, 2026, 8:38 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 8:38 PM ET 36' 8:38 PM ET 3 minutes ago We are nearing the final stretch of the first
 We are nearing the final stretch of the first half, and the visitors head into the break with the lead; the pace of the match has not slowed down, and despite the score, the fans continue to cheer, great match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 Key moments
 8:28 PM ET 24' Goal · Cruz Azul 0-1 
 8:01 PM ET Kickoff 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 32' 8:34 PM ET 8 minutes ago We’ve reached the 30-minute mark
 We’ve reached the 30-minute mark, and the score remains in favor of the *celestes* by one goal; Tigres are looking to respond, but Cruz Azul is defending well and not allowing any space at the moment, great game.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 28' 8:30 PM ET 11 minutes ago Cruz Azul has kept up the pressure and looks
 Cruz Azul has kept up the pressure and looks motivated following the opening goal; they are seeking to extend their lead and maintain control of the match. So far, the hosts have posed very little threat and have yet to register a shot on target.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 24' 8:28 PM ET 14 minutes ago Goal for Cruz Azul!
 Goal for Cruz Azul! The first goal for 'La Máquina' comes via a cross-shot from Ibáñez, giving the visitors the lead—a fantastic strike that puts the visiting side, who have been the better team, ahead.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 22' 8:25 PM ET 17 minutes ago Cruz Azul is attempting to catch Nahuel Guzmán off
 Cruz Azul is attempting to catch Nahuel Guzmán off guard with long-range shots, though he has looked solid at the back; the *Cementeros* keep trying to deliver the ball into the penalty area, but we remain scoreless.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 18' 8:20 PM ET 21 minutes ago There are many fouls occurring that are preventing
 There are many fouls occurring that are preventing the ball from moving forward effectively; there is a high level of intensity in both penalty areas, but a lack of clinical finishing on dangerous plays—the match itself has a good pace.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 14' 8:16 PM ET 26 minutes ago Tigres is starting to respond and is also creating
 Tigres is starting to respond and is also creating plenty of danger in Cruz Azul’s penalty area; we’re seeing an end-to-end match, with chances at both ends and a good pace to the game, great match at moment.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 10' 8:11 PM ET 30 minutes ago The visitors tried to catch Nahuel Guzmán off guard—as
 The visitors tried to catch Nahuel Guzmán off guard—as he was positioned well off his line—but sent their shot wide; they continue to push for the opening goal of the match, while Tigres remain on the defensive during this stretch of play.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6' 8:08 PM ET 34 minutes ago Cruz Azul controls the tempo and maintains possession
 Cruz Azul controls the tempo and maintains possession, increasing the pace of the match as time goes on; neither side is conceding any space at this stage, while Tigres looks to break out of their own half.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 3' 8:04 PM ET 37 minutes ago There is a fierce battle for the ball
 There is a fierce battle for the ball in midfield, and for the moment, neither team has managed to take control; it continues to rain on the pitch at Estadio Universitario, and we shall see how both teams fare as things get underway.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 8:01 PM ET 40 minutes ago Kickoff
 The first half between Tigres and Cruz Azul is underway; this big match has kicked off, and the players are immediately pushing forward to create their first dangerous scoring opportunities, while the fans begin to cheer them on.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:55 PM ET an hour ago Rain at the Universitario
 Heavy rain is beginning to fall on the pitch at Estadio Universitario; the conditions for this match will be challenging, and the surface is sure to be fast—we’ll see which team can adapt to the weather the quickest.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:49 PM ET an hour ago All ready
 Everything is set for this match between Tigres and Cruz Azul; the players are ready and awaiting the signal to take the field, marking the start of a highly anticipated encounter—a great match awaits us in this 16th round.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:44 PM ET an hour ago The team is going for the top spot
 "La Máquina" is contending for the top spot in the overall standings alongside Chivas and América; a win in this match would give them an advantage before their rivals even play their own games. It remains to be seen whether they can secure all 3 points against the "feline" side on what is a challenging pitch.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:39 PM ET an hour ago End of warmup
 Both teams have finished their warm-ups and are heading back to their dressing rooms to receive final instructions from their coaches before returning to the pitch for the start of the first 45 minutes; we are moments away from kick-off.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:35 PM ET an hour ago Tigres lineup
 For their part, this is the lineup Tigres will field as they look to finish the season on a high note—though they no longer have any chance of qualifying for the *liguilla*—with some great players set to take the pitch:
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:29 PM ET an hour ago Cruz Azul lineup
 This is the Cruz Azul lineup to face Tigres in this Matchday 16 encounter in Liga MX; they are fielding their best players, aiming for a win and all 3 points while playing away from home, great lineup:
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:24 PM ET an hour ago Great Entrance
 There is a fantastic turnout at Estadio Universitario; the stadium is nearly full as the players prepare for this big match. "La Máquina" (Cruz Azul) is looking to secure a win and, for the time being, take the top spot in the overall standings—a great atmosphere ahead of kickoff.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:20 PM ET an hour ago Keys to the match
 For this match, Cruz Azul is expected to come out with everything in pursuit of an early lead, bolstered by a much more potent attack and three players who have been called up to the Mexican national team. Tigres will need to play intelligently if they hope to defend effectively in a match that carries high expectations; these are the keys to this major Liga MX encounter.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:20 PM ET an hour ago Fans
 Fans are gradually arriving at Estadio Universitario for this Matchday 16 encounter in Liga MX; there is a strong presence of *felino* (Tigres) supporters, but a large number of Cruz Azul fans have also turned out to support the visitors. The players are about to come out for their warm-up.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:20 PM ET an hour ago Background
 The historical record favors Cruz Azul; in their 15 previous encounters, there have been 6 draws, 4 wins for Tigres, and 6 wins for Cruz Azul. Consequently, the visitors enter tomorrow’s match as the favorites to secure the victory and all 3 points in this Matchday 16 fixture of Liga MX - that is the background heading into this major clash.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:20 PM ET an hour ago How is Cruz Azul heading into this?
 For its part, Cruz Azul comes off a 2-1 victory over León - a result that leaves the team tied for third place with Chivas and América, all with the same number of points. Now, they will face Tigres with the goal of contending for the top spot in the overall standings, which would provide a significant advantage heading into the *liguilla* (playoffs). This is how "La Máquina Celeste" (The Blue Machine) arrives at this match - a contest that promises plenty of intensity, goals, and excitement at the Estadio Universitario.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:50 PM ET 2 hours ago Universitario Stadium
 This is the home of Tigres and one of the most significant stadiums in Liga MX. With a capacity of 42,000 spectators - and having opened on May 30, 1967 - it will host this major match between Tigres and Cruz Azul. A full house is expected, as it is one of the best matchups of the weekend; it is, without a doubt, a great stadium for a great encounter as the Liga MX regular season draws to a close.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:08 PM ET 3 hours ago Referee
 The referee in charge of officiating the match will be the Mexican official Ismael Rosario López Peñuelas. Drawing on his domestic and international experience, he will be tasked with ensuring the match proceeds smoothly - a challenging assignment, given that both teams are known for their high-intensity style of play, which is likely to lead to plenty of physical clashes. He will be the man in the middle for this major encounter during Matchday 16 of the Mexican league.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:24 PM ET 3 hours ago Absences
 Neither team has any injured or suspended players, meaning both can field their full squads - including their top stars - for this match. They will need their best possible lineups if they hope to secure the win and all 3 points. We will have to wait until tomorrow to see the starting XIs for both sides as they look to emerge victorious in what is one of the most important matches.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:00 PM ET 4 hours ago How to watch Tigres vs Cruz Azul Live Stream, TV Channel & Kick-off Times
 Here are the official kick-off times, TV channels and live stream options to watch Tigres vs Cruz Azul in Liga MX Apertura 2026 across major English-speaking regions:
 USA: 8:00 PM EST / 5:00 PM PST - TV & Live Stream on ESPN+, Paramount+, Peacock, fuboTV .
 UK & Ireland: 1:00 AM GMT - Watch live on Sky Sports, TNT Sports, Discovery+ .
 South Africa & Sub-Saharan Africa (Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Uganda): 3:00 AM SAST (2:00 AM WAT in Nigeria / 4:00 AM EAT in Kenya & Uganda) - Broadcast on SuperSport, DStv Stream .
 Canada: 8:00 PM EST / 5:00 PM PST - Live streaming on DAZN Canada, FuboTV Canada, TSN .
 Australia & New Zealand: 12:00 PM AEDT (2:00 PM NZDT in New Zealand) - Watch live on Optus Sport, beIN Sports Australia, Stan Sport .
 UAE & MENA (Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Qatar): 5:00 AM GST (4:00 AM AST in Saudi Arabia & Qatar) - Broadcast on beIN Sports English, TOD .
 India, Malaysia & Singapore: 6:30 AM IST (9:00 AM MYT/SGT in Malaysia & Singapore) - Watch on Sony LIV, Star Sports (India), Astro SuperSport (Malaysia) .

 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Tigres vs Cruz Azul Live Score, Confirmed Lineups & Match Stats
 Follow Tigres UANL vs Cruz Azul live: live score, confirmed lineups, goals, match statistics, the Liga MX Apertura 2026 Matchday 16 standings, and minute-by-minute coverage from Estadio Universitario on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:00 PM ET 4 hours ago How are Tigres coming into this?
 Tigres comes off a 3-0 victory over Pachuca - a match that featured some great moments, though Pachuca ultimately failed to create any real threat. With that defeat, Pachuca is now mathematically eliminated from reaching the *liguilla* (playoffs). Tigres will next face Cruz Azul , aiming to close out the tournament on a high note at home in front of their own fans; that is how *los felinos* head into this major Liga MX clash.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Welcome Friends of VAVEL!
 Welcome to our live coverage of the Tigres vs Cruz Azul match, part of Matchday 16 of Liga MX, taking place at Estadio Universitario.
 My name is Juan Carlos Vera, and I will be your host for this match. We will bring you pre-match analysis, score updates, and live news right here on VAVEL. Follow along for live results, confirmed lineups, goals, match statistics, and the league standings.
